title: Resilience and redundancy
question: Do NSW grids with fewer nearby operator candidates have poorer performance and more persistent decline?
answer: The historical speed gradient appears under the broader operator-candidate classification but is not reproduced under strict PMTS classification. ABS modelled population has been compared without duplicating SA2 totals. Low-broader-candidate groups have no eligible decline windows at 10 km, so greater decline vulnerability cannot be assessed.
method: Strict NSW centroid containment retains 410 of 768 bounding-box grids; 358 are in other states/ACT or unmatched. No offshore snapping or model-history filter. ACMA: 26 October 2026 snapshot; Ookla: 2019 Q1–2026 Q1 historical speeds; ABS: 2024 modelled 1 km population assigned once by cell centre. Comparisons are descriptive.

limits: Spectrum registrations are mobile-compatible candidates, not verified cellular deployments.
Site counts are coordinate-deduplicated registry locations; nearby-location bounds are not validated physical towers.
Strict state containment excludes unmatched offshore/coastal centroids; ACT excluded.
No defensible generation indicator; possible_5g is unknown throughout.
Historical associations with a recent snapshot are descriptive, not predictive or causal.
Strict-only registration classification substantially changes groups.
Self-selected tests and very thin rural histories limit comparisons.
No emergency-call success, voice quality or signal strength was measured.
Licence attribution: Based on Australian Communications and Media Authority information
Raster matching describes pixel availability, not the share of NSW residents served. Fifteen grids have partial raster data; missing pixels are not zero.
Centre/corner assignments put the broader three-candidate population between 6.91 and 7.24 million; this is not a confidence interval.
Strict inventory classification is incomplete and does not reproduce a monotonic speed gradient.
Population is ABS modelled 2024 data, not exact counts or 2026 residents. All grids inherit the candidate count at their centre.
